fixture_model: Every JSONL case is a self-contained synthetic input plus expected answer mode, expected fields, and hard invariants. The locked stdlib reference runner derives an actual decision from domain/category/input and compares it with the expected answer mode while computing invariant, retrieval, and extraction metrics. No user data, network access, live credential, or mutable external fixture is permitted.

runner.dependencies: Python standard library only; no project discovery, package resolution, virtualenv, or tests-integration/uv.lock is used by the eval runner.
runner.uv: 0.11.7 (9d177269e 2026-04-15); used only to provision/select exact CPython with --no-project

case_contract.expected_output_location: Each case's expected object; run.py emits actual_answer_mode and compares it to expected.answer_mode for every case
case_contract.hard_invariant_policy: Every named invariant must pass; missing execution is incomplete, not pass.

metrics.formulas: The locked metrics artifact defines denominators and formulas for Recall@10, nDCG@10, schema validity, evidence-span exactness, supported-claim precision, and confirmed unsupported claims.

critical_regression: Any hard-invariant failure; confirmed unsupported claim; unauthorized mutation/read; purged-data read/decrypt/resurrection; secret/local_only egress; silent overwrite; lost/duplicate event; evidence hash mismatch; or retrieval metric drop greater than 0.02 absolute from the promoted baseline.
promotion_policy: A candidate is promotable only when every hard invariant passes, every threshold is met, no metric regresses by more than 0.02 absolute, artifacts match this byte lock, and the run emits failure samples and environment metadata.
